Token usage of the /implement runs recorded for this directory (from Claude Code session data) (construct cost v<version>)

USAGE construct cost [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                    
      --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)
     --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)             
       --last    Only the most recent run (Default: false)        
       --json    Machine-readable report (Default: false)
